issues: Several Pexels migration images don't match a 'driving school in Switzerland' vibe: Lachen shows a building/dealership, Altendorf and Rapperswil show large freight trucks (semi-trailers on a forest highway). These read more as US trucking stock than Swiss driving-school photography. Consider replacing with curated CH road/scenic photos via the admin inline upload (which now works perfectly).

critical_code_review_comments: BrandLogo.jsx uses inline absolute-positioned upload button only when editMode=true — correct and tested. Note the upload PATCHes content.logo_url globally via updateField, which means a single admin can break ALL pages' headers and footers with one bad image. Consider an undo/preview before commit.

OtherLocationsSection.jsx wraps the entire card in a <Link>, then mounts the upload <button type='button'> AND a hidden <input type='file'> inside that link with e.preventDefault()/stopPropagation() guards in onClick. This works (verified) but is fragile — a future Link/Button library upgrade could break stopPropagation. A cleaner pattern: render the card as a non-anchor and use a separate onClick handler for navigation, leaving the upload button outside the navigation surface.

Footer locations list is fetched client-side on every footer mount via /api/locations. Since Footer renders on every page, this is N requests per session even though /api/content already contains most config. Consider lifting locations into a shared context or caching via SWR/react-query (already a dependency).

CanonicalLink.jsx imperatively mutates document.head but the cleanup intentionally leaves the tag in place. If a future page forgets to render <CanonicalLink>, a stale tag from the previous page will persist. Recommend either clearing on unmount OR adding CanonicalLink on every public page (Layout-level).

Backend default_pages.py one-time Unsplash→Pexels migration (server.py:653-660) is idempotent (no-op on subsequent runs because URLs no longer match unsplash.com), but it has no version flag — if the Pexels URLs themselves break in future, there's no clean way to re-trigger. Consider storing a content.migration_version key.
Frontend Footer.jsx and BrandLogo.jsx now total ~250 LOC combined; healthy. No file >700 LOC.

Instead, first probe the state via brand-logo-upload-header count (1 → editMode ON, 0 → editMode OFF) and only toggle if needed. Toolbar button label flips: shows 'BEARBEITEN' when active (edit ON) OR when inactive (preview ON, click to edit) — relying on text is ambiguous, use the upload-icon probe pattern. rca of the issue: Initial Playwright run incorrectly reported 0/10 other-region-upload buttons in admin edit mode. RCA: edit-mode state was already ON when the page loaded (persisted via localStorage from a previous admin session in the browser context). Clicking toolbar-toggle-edit then turned edit-mode OFF, hiding all upload buttons. Fixed by probing brand-logo-upload-header count first and only toggling when needed — second run found exactly 10/10 upload buttons correctly rendered.
